name: cloud.shoplive.sdk.common.provider.ShopLiveAuthProvider
description: Android starts this Provider with the app process. It initializes ShopLive's saved guest and client identifiers, then retrieves the device advertising ID for the ShopLive live-commerce SDK.
disableEffect: Disabling it leaves ShopLive without startup identifiers used by its live and video features, which can prevent those features from initializing or making requests.
